items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-28
items.q: You mentioned this Thacker, was that her name again?

ctx.x: They used to holler, hey now. Remember, hey now? We would be full of wine and things, you know. Dance in the street and everything. They'd probably do a naked dance in the street. They'd never had on nothing. Have a sandwich in the street, actually. That's the truth. Huh? That's the truth. They'll have a sandwich in the street, huh? Sure. Sure. You were talking the other night about the Coom Shouters, you called them, up at, was that at Pete Lala's? You mentioned this Thacker, was that her name again? Yeah. and…
